answer: Identity verification tests reasoning persistence across isolated island environments. Each node signs claims with a cryptographic quill and locks 2500 dollars into an escrow vault. Verifiers immediately issue fresh entropy seeds, forcing the candidate to re-derive 4096 reasoning tokens within three seconds. If recomputed paths diverge from deterministic execution traces, the vault burns posted capital and evicts the node. Sustaining one thousand fraudulent clones demands 850 teraflops of redundant GPU compute, rendering parallel identity spoofing unprofitable.
